[Uploading Amuuu Happy birthday .html…]()
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Happy Birthday My Love ❤️</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Great+Vibes&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;
    color:white;
    min-height:100vh;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at top,#5a071d 0%,#160008 45%,#050002 100%);
}
body::before{
    content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%,rgba(255,0,80,.18),transparent 20%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 40%,rgba(255,0,100,.15),transparent 25%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 90%,rgba(255,50,100,.12),transparent 25%);
}
.container{max-width:1000px;margin:auto;text-align:center;padding:70px 20px}
.main-title{
    font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:clamp(4rem,10vw,8rem);
    color:white;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 10px #ff1f5b,0 0 30px #ff1f5b,0 0 60px #d00045;
    animation:titleGlow 2s infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes titleGlow{
    from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.02);text-shadow:0 0 15px #ff1f5b,0 0 50px #ff1f5b,0 0 90px #ff1f5b}
}
.favorite{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,4rem);margin-top:10px;color:#fff5f6}
.love{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;color:#ff5a82;font-size:clamp(3.5rem,8vw,6rem);margin:10px 0 25px}
.intro{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 30px;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.7;color:#ffe8ec}
.highlight{color:#ff5d85;font-weight:bold}
.photo-frame{
    width:min(90vw,550px);margin:35px auto;padding:12px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#ffd6df,#fff);border-radius:30px;
    box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff2d62,0 0 40px rgba(255,20,80,.8),0 0 80px rgba(255,20,80,.4);
    animation:photoGlow 3s infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes photoGlow{
    from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.015);box-shadow:0 0 25px #ff2d62,0 0 70px rgba(255,20,80,.8),0 0 120px rgba(255,20,80,.5)}
}
.photo-frame img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:20px;object-fit:contain}
.you-are{margin:35px 0 20px;font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:4rem;color:#fff}
.love-points{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:15px;margin-bottom:35px}
.point{min-width:150px;padding:20px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);font-family:'Playfair Display',serif}
.point:last-child{border-right:none}
.emoji{display:block;font-size:2.5rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.message-box{
    max-width:750px;margin:30px auto;padding:30px 25px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,120,150,.3);border-radius:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,70,.15);
}
.message-box p,#surprise p{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.7;color:#ffe8ec}
.final-love{display:block;margin-top:15px;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:bold;color:#ff6d90}
button{
    margin-top:20px;border:none;padding:20px 55px;border-radius:20px;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
    font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:bold;color:white;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff174f,#ff4f78);
    cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 15px #ff174f,0 0 40px rgba(255,20,79,.6);transition:.3s;
}
button:hover{transform:scale(1.08);box-shadow:0 0 30px #ff174f,0 0 70px #ff174f}
.small-text{margin-top:20px;font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:2rem;color:#ffe8ec}
#surprise{
    display:none;margin-top:40px;padding:40px 25px;border-radius:25px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,20,80,.2),rgba(80,0,20,.4));
    border:1px solid #ff5a82;animation:appear 1.5s ease;
}
#surprise h2{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;font-size:4rem;color:#ff7b9c;margin-bottom:20px}
@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(50px) scale(.95)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
.floating-heart{position:fixed;bottom:-60px;pointer-events:none;animation:floatUp linear forwards;z-index:10;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #ff174f)}
@keyframes floatUp{from{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0);opacity:0}10%{opacity:1}to{transform:translateY(-120vh) rotate(360deg);opacity:0}}
@media(max-width:600px){
    .container{padding:50px 15px}.point{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
    .you-are{font-size:3rem}.message-box p,#surprise p{font-size:1.1rem}button{width:90%;padding:18px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">
    <h1 class="main-title">Happy Birthday Amruta ❤️</h1>
    <h2 class="favorite">My Favourite Person ❤️</h2>
    <div class="love">and My Love ❤️</div>

    <p class="intro">
        Today is all about <span class="highlight">YOU!</span><br>
        The most amazing, beautiful, kind and adorable person who makes my life so much better just by being in it.
        <br><br><span class="highlight">I'm so lucky to have you in my life. ❤️</span>
    </p>

    <!-- Photo is embedded directly inside this file -->
    <div class="photo-frame">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="My Love and Me ❤️">
    </div>

    <div class="you-are">You are... ✨</div>

    <div class="love-points">
        <div class="point"><span class="emoji">❤️</span>My Happiness</div>
        <div class="point"><span class="emoji">✨</span>My Peace</div>
        <div class="point"><span class="emoji">🌸</span>My Strength</div>
        <div class="point"><span class="emoji">∞</span>My Forever</div>
    </div>

    <div class="message-box">
        <p>
            Thank you for coming into my life and making it so beautiful.<br>
            You are not just my love, you are my best friend, my safe place and my greatest blessing.
            <span class="final-love">Forever yours, with all my love, Amruta ❤️</span>
        </p>
    </div>

    <button onclick="showSurprise()">Happy Birthday My Love Amuu ❤️</button>
    <div class="small-text">There's a little surprise waiting for you... ❤️</div>

    <div id="surprise">
        <h2>My Forever ❤️</h2>
        <p>
            Happy Birthday, My Love! 🎂❤️<br><br>
            I hope this new year of your life brings you every happiness you deserve.<br><br>
            I promise to always celebrate your smiles, support you during difficult days, and love you with all my heart.<br><br>
            No matter how many birthdays pass, you will always be the most special person to me.<br><br>
            <b>I choose you.<br>Today.<br>Tomorrow.<br>And every day after that. ❤️</b><br><br>
            <span style="color:#ff6d90;font-size:1.5rem">Happy Birthday once again, my beautiful love! ❤️🎂✨</span>
        </p>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
function showSurprise(){
    const surprise=document.getElementById("surprise");
    surprise.style.display="block";
    surprise.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
    for(let i=0;i<80;i++) createHeart();
}
function createHeart(){
    const heart=document.createElement("div");
    heart.className="floating-heart";
    const hearts=["❤️","💖","💕","💗","✨","💝"];
    heart.innerHTML=hearts[Math.floor(Math.random()*hearts.length)];
    heart.style.left=Math.random()*100+"vw";
    heart.style.fontSize=(Math.random()*30+18)+"px";
    heart.style.animationDuration=(Math.random()*5+5)+"s";
    document.body.appendChild(heart);
    setTimeout(()=>heart.remove(),10000);
}
setInterval(()=>{if(Math.random()>.4) createHeart()},900);
</script>
</body>
</html>
